rv.q: Heathers is darkly comic fun, performed by a talented cast.
Gerardine Sacdalan is the emotional anchor of the production, delivering a commanding vocal performance while charting the character's emotional journey with warmth and conviction.
The plot may be dark, but the music is upbeat, and the cast are enthusiastic and very talented.
Heathers The Musical is the perfect excuse to dig out your snazzy plaid, matching socks and scrunchies, snack on corn nuts, and be 17 again – whether you ever felt 'normal' or not.

Whether you are a devoted fan of the film or simply looking for a high-energy night of iconic songs and genuine comedy, this is a show that will have you bopping along from the first note to the last.
